run_diatomic_curve_test: run a diatomic potential energy curve test for molecules using a pretrained MLIP model
compute_diatomic_curve: compute the diatomic potential energy curve for a pair of atoms across a range of distances
get_model: load a pretrained machine learning interatomic potential model for energy prediction
generate_plot: generate a plot of the diatomic potential energy curve and save it as a PNG image
combined_plot: generate a combined plot of multiple diatomic potential energy curves in a single figure
